title.en: Let the proof assistant prove it

t.zh: <level-ref to="q-ancestor"></level-ref>和<level-ref to="s-carroll"></level-ref>都亲手证过，这一次交给证明助手。
t.en: <level-ref to="q-ancestor"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="s-carroll"></level-ref> were proved by hand; this time, hand them to the proof assistant.

hyps: ∀x. ∀y. ∀z. Anc(x, y) ∧ Anc(y, z) → Anc(x, z)

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：推得出的目标证出来，推不出的报告失败。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves the goals that follow and reports failure on those that do not.
